transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well... I'm here because everybody keeps acting like I'm imagining things. But I'm not. 

I know my wife's relative has been coming into the house to get at me. My tools don't just move themselves. And my fishing plans don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been months of this. I can see plain as day he's trying to take over my place and push me out. 

...But I guess you're just gonna say the same thing they do.
Do you think there is any possible non-paranormal explanation for these events?

I don't know why you're saying paranormal. I never said anything about ghosts or magic. 

...It's just her relative. Like I already told you. He's a real person. He comes into the house, messes with my tools... ruins my fishing. 

...I don't know why I have to keep repeating it. He's just trying to push me out. That's all there is to it.
Have you always been this suspicious and mistrustful of other people, or did this only start recently?

I'm not... I don't just go around mistrusting people. I'm not a suspicious guy. I just know what's happening in my own house. 

...It's been about nine months. Just... ever since her relative moved in with us. Didn't have any of these problems before he showed up.
Have you heard any voices that other people could not hear?

No. ...I don't know why you'd ask that. I don't hear things. 

...I'm not hearing voices. I just see what he's doing to my stuff. That's all.
Before this started, have you generally been the kind of person who trusts other people, or have you usually been very suspicious of their motives?

I just told you. I'm not a suspicious guy. I trust people fine... when they aren't sneaking around my house messing with my things. 

...I don't know what else you want me to say about it. I was fine before he got here.
How long has it been going on altogether?
I thought I just... I already told you that. It's been about nine months. Just... since my wife's relative moved into the house. That's how long.
Outside of this situation with your wife’s relative, have you generally had a hard time trusting other people?

No. ...I don't know why you're asking me that again. 

I don't have problems with anyone else. I go to work, I get along with the guys at the shop just fine. It's... it's just him.
Does your wife believe that her relative is coming into the house and messing with your things too?

No. She doesn't. 

That's... that's why I'm here. Because everyone keeps acting like I'm making it up. Like I'm imagining it. 

But I'm not. I know he's coming in here to get at me. My tools at the workbench... they don't just move themselves. And every weekend, my fishing plans... they don't just get spoiled by accident. Not every time. 

It's been months of this. I can see it plain as day, even if she won't. He's... he's trying to take over my place. Trying to push me out of my own house.
If your wife showed you clear proof that her relative has not been entering the house, would you believe her?

I don't... I don't see how she could show me that. 

Proof? What proof? I'm telling you, I know he's coming in. I'm not... I'm not imagining it. My tools don't move themselves. The plans don't just get ruined every single weekend by coincidence. 

It's been months. I see what he's doing. He's trying to push me out. I don't need... I don't need proof that he isn't, because I know he is.
Have you ever heard a voice when no one else was around?

No. ...I don't hear voices. 

I don't know why you'd ask me that. I don't hear anything like that. I'm just telling you what's actually happening with my things. That's all.
Has this belief been affecting your ability to work or handle everyday tasks?

No. I still get up... go to the plant. Do my assembler work. I keep the bills paid and take care of myself, just like I always have. None of that has changed. 

The only trouble is... well, it's just centered on what's happening in my house. With him, and my things. That's it.
Have you often felt that other people were out to use, harm, or deceive you even before this situation started?

No. Not really. 

I've never... I don't have problems with people like that. Just him. Just what he's doing to my house. That's all there is to it.
Have you ever had any other unusual experiences, like seeing things other people couldn’t see?

No. ...I don't see things. 

I don't know why we keep going over this kind of stuff. I just see what's actually there. My eyesight is fine.
Aside from your wife’s relative, do you believe anyone else is trying to harm, watch, or control you?
No. Just him. I already said that. It's just him messing with my house. Nobody else.
Have you ever had beliefs like this about other people before, or is it only this one relative?
No. Just him. I... I don't know how many different ways I can say it. It's just him. I've never had this problem with anybody else.
Have you ever had any other strange beliefs or experiences that other people would say are not real?
No. ...Look, I don't have strange beliefs. Everything I'm telling you is actually happening. I don't know what else you want me to say to you. There's nothing else.
Have you had any other fixed beliefs that other people think are untrue?
I... I just told you. No. I don't... I don't have "untrue" beliefs. I'm just telling you what he's doing. That's it.
Have you had any periods where you felt unusually high, energized, or needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I sleep normal. I don't... I don't know why you're asking me all this. I just go to work, do my job, and I get tired like anybody else. I don't have that.
Have other people ever told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No. Nobody's ever said that to me. I... I speak plain. People understand me fine. I don't jump around, I just... I just talk like I always do.
Have you noticed any change in your ability to work, care for yourself, or handle everyday life since this started?

No. I... I still get up, go to the plant. Do my assembler work. Keep the bills paid. I take care of myself like I always have. I don't have trouble with any of that. 

The only issue is... well, it's just what's happening in my house. With him. And my things. Everything else is fine.
